newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen staying flat on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen staying flat on Tuesday.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to extend their recent flat performance, signalled by mixed sessions at order balancing after price-fixing and at continuous trade on Monday.
Analysts said the overall trend should be slightly downward in the run-up to September's parliamentary elections but that the main market, currently at 15,148.8 points, could hover around 15,000.
They said Budimex should rebound on Tuesday after its recent plunge on news it had revised down its 1997 profit forecast.
